subject: literacy
concept: Writing a short piece combining narrative or informational structure with self-editing, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their piece using a simple beginning/middle/end or fact-list graphic organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short multi-sentence piece (narrative or informational), then self-edits it using the checklist

assessment.mastery_threshold: piece has clear structure, uses at least 2 describing words, and shows evidence of self-editing

interest_binding: topic/prompt generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
